label: Data transform: backfill RunSignup.publishedRole from selected draft / sole offer

execute.description: Copy selected RunRosterEntry.selectedRole onto SELECTED BOOSTER signups
execute.sql:
UPDATE "run_signup" AS s
SET "publishedRole" = e."selectedRole",
    "updatedAt" = now()
FROM "run_roster_entry" AS e
WHERE e."signupId" = s."id"
  AND e."selected" = true
  AND s."status" = 'SELECTED'
  AND s."participationType" = 'BOOSTER'
  AND e."selectedRole" IS NOT NULL
  AND s."publishedRole" IS NULL

execute.description: Infer publishedRole from a sole offered role when no selectedRole exists
execute.sql:
UPDATE "run_signup" AS s
SET "publishedRole" = sole."role",
    "updatedAt" = now()
FROM (
  SELECT r."signupId", MIN(r."role") AS "role"
  FROM "run_signup_role" r
  GROUP BY r."signupId"
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
) AS sole
WHERE sole."signupId" = s."id"
  AND s."status" = 'SELECTED'
  AND s."participationType" = 'BOOSTER'
  AND s."publishedRole" IS NULL

postcheck.description: Every SELECTED BOOSTER with a resolvable role has publishedRole (selectedRole or sole offer)
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM "run_signup" s
  WHERE s."status" = 'SELECTED'
    AND s."participationType" = 'BOOSTER'
    AND s."publishedRole" IS NULL
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM "run_roster_entry" e
        WHERE e."signupId" = s."id"
          AND e."selected" = true
          AND e."selectedRole" IS NOT NULL
      )
      OR (
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "run_signup_role" r WHERE r."signupId" = s."id"
      ) = 1
    )
) AS ok
